variants.name: 팝 스티커
variants.initial_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise-object-edit.
Make ONE finished alternative HUD concept applied directly to Input1, the user's real game screenshot. Output the gameplay screenshot alone, original 3406:1407 aspect ratio, highest practical resolution. No concept-sheet panels, external title, comparison layout, annotations or watermark.
Input1 is the DIRECT EDIT TARGET. Completely replace its original HUD. Preserve the game scene, framing, camera, original purple floor/walls, pink physical barriers and arrows, fixtures, central olive mech holding the sword toward upper-right, TWO white cube enemies with red eyes (one upper-left-of-center and one lower-left), TWO orange barrels, pale mint round/ring-shaped partner drone below-left of player, original explosion and projectiles to the right. Reconstruct background only underneath removed interface. Do not redesign characters, environment, lighting or action.
Input2 is the previous HUD concept, ONLY a guide to which functions, values and PC input labels need to be represented; its panel shapes/layout need not remain. Create a genuinely distinct composition and graphic language, not a recoloring.
Maintain these readable state values: player health 4/5, rooms0/9, enemies6, score0, ammo26/30, missile quantity4, TRIAD FOLLOW with EMPTY support0/100. Player energy shown ONCE as one mint pip and two dim pips. No duplicate old floating bars or pips.
IMPORTANT NEW REQUIREMENT: clearly visible ENEMY HEALTH BARS above BOTH actual white red-eyed cube enemies. Upper cube near normalized x.385 y.17, lower-left cube near x.25 y.67. Each gets ONE coral-red bar with a dark empty tail and a thin white/ink boundary, centered directly above its head with a clear gap. About width1.1 times its body, height8-10px at output1950x805. Upper bar about80% full, lower bar about60% full, illustrative only. No numerical HP values, no labels and no long bars stretched across arena. Never put enemy bars above orange barrels, the companion drone, or UI icons. Never omit either enemy bar.
Controls must remain unmistakable and wholly in frame: sword LMB, gun RMB with reload T next to its26/30 count, dodge SPACE, boost SHIFT, rocket R with4, laser L+R. These are compact PC legends, not a mobile joystick. Companion has Q DOCK and X SHIELD muted/disabled because support is0, Z CLEAN active. No heal spell, no currencies, shop, timers, fake cooldown numbers or READY labels.
Take mo.co's playful readable casual design principles: bold sans lettering, compact missions, illustrated object icons with a clear contour, selective purple/mint accents, empty central combat view. No neon tech line glyphs, circuitry, chrome, photoreal glass, metal HUD bevels or dense microtext. All UI inside a generous safe margin; do not cover either enemy, player or actual companion. Distinguish player green health from enemy coral health.

STYLE 1: GRAPHIC POP STICKERS. A bold streetwear sticker collage with warm off-white paper faces, thick deep-violet outlines, short offset violet drop shadows, mint corner tabs and selected accent, a small magenta marker accent. Flat clean screenprint colors, slightly tilted headers but orderly body text. Much more off-white than the previous violet HUD. No fake paper grunge or noisy distressed texture.
Layout: a compact white mission ticket UPPER LEFT with purple bold ROOMS0/9 and ENEMIES6; tiny mint HEXBLADE sticker attached to ticket edge. Player health stays attached ABOVE the center mech, a small green capsule with white4/5 and subordinate orange strip and energy pips. Minimap UPPER RIGHT on a small white-faced violet-edged card, dark map ink and pink/mint markers, SCORE0 as a short footer. Companion LOWER LEFT on an off-white violet-outline horizontally divided small ticket with same drone illustration, TRIAD/FOLLOW, empty support0/100 and three Q/X/Z action stamps below. Disabled Q/X are washed gray with readable labels; Z mint. Controls LOWER RIGHT as a staggered two-row set of individual SMALL OFF-WHITE ROUNDED-SQUARE STICKER TILES rather than circles, dark violet labels and bold colorful simplified sword/gun/boot/jet/rocket/energy-cell objects. Main sword tile larger and slightly tilted; gun tile has both RMB and T badges, count26/30. Enemy health bars use short off-white backing tabs with coral fills. Keep the white tickets compact, not huge white dashboards. This version should feel graphic, energetic, poster-like and playful.
variants.correction_prompt: Edit this exact same POP STICKER HUD screenshot. Keep all objects, UI, wording, layout, colors and style unchanged. Make only two tiny stale-overlay removals: erase the obsolete row of three faint energy dots on the floor left of player near x735..784,y308 in this1951x806 image; KEEP the NEW three energy pips directly under4/5 health above player. Erase the tiny obsolete beige health line immediately above the LOWER-LEFT white cube, beneath its NEW CORAL WHITE-BORDERED health bar. KEEP BOTH new enemy coral bars above both cube heads. Reconstruct floor beneath only those obsolete dots and beige line. No other modification, no new drawing or border.
